Jesus... my father is in the ICU and I'm stuck in another city. The next train is tomorrow night.

His father is in the ICU, and he's stuck in another city until tomorrow night. His mother keeps saying "don't worry" with a shaking voice.

Jesus: "You can't be in two places. I can. Let Me be where you can't."

"So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand."
Isaiah 41:10 (NIV)

youtube_description:
Jesus... my father is in the ICU and I'm stuck in another city. The next train is tomorrow night.

His father is in the ICU, and he's stuck in another city until tomorrow night. His mother keeps saying "don't worry" with a shaking voice.

Him: Jesus... my father is in the ICU and I'm stuck in another city. The next train is tomorrow night. 😭

Him: Mom keeps saying "don't worry." Her voice is shaking.

Jesus: I'm in that ICU right now. I'm beside your father, and I'm beside you.

Him: What if something happens before I get there?

Jesus: You can't be in two places. I can. Let Me be where you can't.

Him: I don't even know how to pray right now.

Jesus: Then just say his name to Me. I'll know the rest.

"So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand."
Isaiah 41:10 (NIV)

Jesus: Call your mother back. Be strong for her, and let Me be strong for you.
